import math
p=(1.50,3.52); h=0.1
def gp(u,v):
    D=396.8/(v-256); L=1.55*(u-256)/(v-256)
    hr=math.radians(h); f=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); r=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
    return (round(p[0]+D*f[0]+L*r[0],2), round(p[1]+D*f[1]+L*r[1],2))
def hz(vt,vb):
    D=396.8/(vb-256); return round(1.55-(vt-256)*D/256,2)
